lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. The pattern consists of approximately four discernible vertical columns of spots, with centroids aligned in a coordinate space between the medial and superior carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines to form a lattice. The highest-intensity blobs are positioned precisely at the nodes where vertical light-intensity bands cross the horizontal linear ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features run horizontally. The most prominent medial ridge shows a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity upper boundary and a low-intensity shadowed lower boundary, extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small-diameter high-luminance spots, significantly more concentrated and less ordered than the pattern on the lateral flank.
